title: Part (b): the end slice ρ(x) = ω(ι(s, x)) ∘ J is a test form
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ, s ∈ ℝ and ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N+1}) (ω : TestFormOn univ k). Write ι(t, x) := (t, x_1, …, x_N) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) and Jv := ι(0, v). Then there exists ρ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) (ρ : TestFormOn univ k) with ρ(x)(v_1, …, v_k) = ω(ι(s, x))(Jv_1, …, Jv_k) for all x ∈ ℝ^N and v ∈ (ℝ^N)^k.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) k), ∃ ρ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, ∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (ρ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))
